\ Loading the package:  
```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(SVCCluster)
```

\ Testing the `SVC` function at the iris dataset:
```{r}
res <- SVC(data=iris[,1:4],sigma=2,varredura=10,kernel="gaussian")
plot(iris[,1:4],col=factor(res$grupos))
```
